  3. <fidel-sign-answer>

<fidel-sign-answer>

Answer in sign language. Record a short video answer with the camera, watch it back, then send it; or use the phone's camera app.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Deaf learners whose first language is Ethiopian Sign Language, to reply, ask or explain without writing.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት። This example has no upload-url, so nothing is uploaded.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-sign-answer label="Ask your question in sign language"
  upload-url="/your/api/answers" max-seconds="120"></fidel-sign-answer>

Source: player/src/components/d/sign-answer.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-sign-answer>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
labeltextnoneThe heading of the box.
upload-urlURLnoneWhere Send POSTs the video (multipart field video). Without it, the page gets the video as an event.
max-secondsseconds120Longest recording.
heading-level2 to 53Level of the component's heading, so it fits your page's outline.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-sign-answer>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-sign-answer-ready{ blob, durationSeconds, mimeType }Without upload-url: the recording for the page.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Start camera (only then is the camera asked for), Record after a 3-2-1 countdown in text, Stop recording, watch it back (Slower 0.5×), Record again or Send.
  • Focus moves to each step's heading. With no camera, it says so and offers a video file instead.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.4.3 Focus Order: Focus moves to each step's heading.
  • 1.4.1 Use of Color: "Camera on" and "Recording" are written in words.
  • The camera starts only when the learner presses a button, is shown while on, and goes off as soon as recording stops.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
